relations.subject: Dilgo Khyentse
relations.evidence: He had received Dzogchen teachings from two teachers, namely Dilgo Khyentse and Trulshik Rinpoche. Both of them were students of the Second Dudjom Rinpoche

relations.subject: Trulshik Rinpoche

relations.subject: 14th Dalai Lama
relations.evidence: Within the Dzogchen lineage, or the "Great Perfection", the 14th Dalai Lama is also a lineage holder. He had received Dzogchen teachings from two teachers, namely Dilgo Khyentse and Trulshik Rinpoche.

relations.subject: Sangharakshita
